title: 机器学习与生成式AI项目合集
summary: 该GitHub仓库汇集了使用Python构建的机器学习、深度学习、生成式AI和AI自动化项目，涵盖AI智能体、LLM应用、NLP、计算机视觉和API等真实业务场景，代码整洁且文档完善。
summary_en: A GitHub repository featuring real-world Python projects in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and AI Automation, including AI agents, LLM apps, NLP, computer vision, and APIs with clean, scalable, well-documented code.
